# Vendored renderer

This is the archify diagram renderer (MIT, © 2026 tt-a1i; original "architecture-diagram-generator" © 2025 Cocoon AI), vendored so the diagram-atlas skill builds without any other skill installed. Included: `bin/`, `renderers/`, `schemas/`, `scripts/` (the final artifact checker runs from here), `assets/template.html`, `brand-marks/`, `examples/`, `recipes/`, `references/`, `delta/`. Only the test suite is omitted. Requires Node 18 or newer; no npm install.

Do not edit files here. To upgrade, replace the folder from a newer archify release and re-run the example build in this skill.
